pages:acceptable-use-policy.title: Acceptable Use Policy
pages:acceptable-use-policy.description: Lists allowed and prohibited usage of a service or platform with check and cross icons. Includes a violation reporting section. Suitable for SaaS, hosting, and community platforms.

pages:accessibility-statement.title: Accessibility Statement
pages:accessibility-statement.description: Shows WCAG conformance level, accessibility features, and issue reporting options.

pages:cookie-policy.title: Cookie Policy
pages:cookie-policy.description: A complete cookie policy explaining each cookie type, its purpose, and whether it is required or optional.

pages:end-user-license-agreement.title: End User License Agreement
pages:end-user-license-agreement.description: A complete end-user license agreement with numbered clauses for license grant, restrictions, intellectual property, warranties, and liability.

pages:privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
pages:privacy-policy.description: A complete privacy policy covering data collection, usage, sharing, retention, rights, and security in a readable legal flow.

pages:terms-of-service.title: Terms of Service
pages:terms-of-service.description: A complete terms-of-service document with numbered sections, clear headings, effective date, and readable legal text.
